newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, TRADED VOLUME RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, TRADED VOLUME RISE.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume rose at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold a total of 393 shares at 1,000 denars, unchanged from Tuesday's close and below par of 2,424 denars.
Traded volume was 290 shares at the previous session on Tuesday when only Alkaloid stocks traded at 1,000-1,009 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
